scope: The Meridian Square entrance, above-ground platform shapes and footbridge follow the signed PMTiles frame and ordinary photographs. The concrete apron fits the sampled plaza, platform slabs and canopies follow raised platform grades, and the public footbridge reaches the mapped Meridian Steps.
limits: Platform grades, canopy supports and steps are visual reconstructions from standard terrain, mapped rail alignments and ordinary photographs. They have no surveyed rail clearances or accessibility data.
The Westfield-side footbridge end is modeled to its mapped endpoint. The shopping centre, bus station, Stratford International and underground railway interiors use their own scene data.
